records.canvas_ruling: A map CANVAS CANNOT BE HONESTLY FAKED. The canvas region is therefore a TYPED ABSENCE that names WHICH absence it is: the reference's canvas draws a real basemap and its "No layers" is an EMPTY layer list on top of a map that exists; the estate's canvas is MISSING. The port renders no canvas element, no svg geometry, no tile source and no borrowed vendor basemap — a drawn map would be a fabricated reference, and it would erase exactly the missing-vs-empty distinction this program exists to hold. The four things a real canvas would need are NAMED on-surface rather than implied: a geometry-bearing record type, a coordinate reference system, a tile or vector basemap source, and a layer plane binding them — each an authority-and-plane cut, never a UI cut.
